hero.subtitle: Virtual workshops and classes leading up to an in-person quantum computing competition at ITBA.

about.title: What is QuantumJam?
about.description: A Computer Society ITBA event in two independent parts: a series of virtual workshops and classes, followed by a one-day, in-person quantum computing competition at ITBA. Both are 100% free — competition day (about 8 hours) includes food, a workspace, and mentors for every team.

beginner.title: No prior experience needed
beginner.desc: New to quantum computing? Perfect — you'll leave knowing what a qubit is, what superposition means, and how to code with them.

hands_on.title: Hands-on with Qiskit
hands_on.desc: Build and run your first quantum circuit using Qiskit's simulator, modeled on IBM's real processors.

community.title: Community
community.desc: Technical talks and networking with the Buenos Aires quantum community.

hardware.title: The hardware
hardware.description: This is what an IBM Quantum processor looks like: each qubit lives in a superconducting circuit, cooled to a fraction of a degree above absolute zero. At QuantumJam you won't need a cryostat — every circuit you build runs on Qiskit's simulator, modeled faithfully on this real IBM architecture.

specs.arch_value: Same topology as IBM's real devices

workshops.label: Virtual workshops
workshops.desc: Regular online sessions on our Discord server. Registration required.

competition.label: Competition day
competition.desc: November 14 · ~8 hours, in person at ITBA SDF.

sponsor.title: IBM Quantum
sponsor.description: IBM Quantum powers QuantumJam with Qiskit, the open-source framework used to build, simulate, and run every circuit — modeled on IBM's real quantum processors.

hardware.label: Simulator
hardware.value: Qiskit's simulator, modeled on the same superconducting processors IBM runs in production.

software.label: Software
software.value: Qiskit, the open-source SDK used to build and run every circuit.

support.label: Support
support.value: Mentors on-site, guiding every team throughout the day.
